items.title: George "Kid Sheik" Colar Interview, 1958-07-20
items.q: Can you remember much about Frankie Dooson in his old days?

ctx.x: Never did. Never did. Yeah. But, uh, the most honored of Keppert and Oliver's were, what I've been hearing these days. Oh, man. Uh, during that time, I might have seen them and things, but I can't remember anything.
Can you remember much about Frankie Dooson in his old days?
